about: Volume normalization: the gain (dB) applied to a track whose YouTube loudnessDb is known, for a chosen target in LUFS (default -14). gain = target + 14 - loudnessDb, limited to -15..+3 dB. Rust nuvx-core::loudness and Android loudnessGainMb (in millibels, rounded) must agree.

cases.name: default target, track at the reference
quiet track is boosted at most 3 dB
very loud track is cut at most 15 dB
fractions round to a hundredth of a dB on Android
